  "extract_plan": {
    "chunk_summary": "Section 8 grounds State Fidelity Validity (SFV) monitoring institutionally: it maps SFV monitoring onto the NIST AI RMF's Measure function and TEVV, argues a specification gap exists between NIST/FCSM frameworks and operational practice, connects SFV threats T1–T5 to FCSM quality dimensions, and argues AI-assisted workflows shift the cost model for provenance infrastructure that made IBM DOORS-style traceability unaffordable."
  },
  "concepts": [
    {"id": "c-sfv", "name": "SFV", "aliases": ["State Fidelity Validity"], "description": "The validity framework this paper develops, positioned as not existing in a methodological vacuum.", "anchor": "SFV does not exist", "location": "8 Institutional Grounding"},
    {"id": "c-sfv-monitoring", "name": "SFV monitoring", "aliases": ["state fidelity monitoring"], "description": "The assessment activity the paper proposes, classed as a TEVV activity and a component of an agency's Measure function.", "anchor": "monitoring is a TEVV activity", "location": "8.1 The NIST AI RMF and TEVV"},
    {"id": "c-tevv", "name": "TEVV", "aliases": ["Test, Evaluation, Verification, and Validation"], "description": "The systematic assessment activities specified by the NIST AI RMF Measure function.", "anchor": "Verification, and Validation (TEVV)", "location": "8.1 The NIST AI RMF and TEVV"},
    {"id": "c-measure-function", "name": "Measure function", "aliases": [], "description": "The NIST AI RMF function that specifies TEVV and into which SFV monitoring can be incorporated.", "anchor": "Measure function specifies", "location": "8.1 The NIST AI RMF and TEVV"},
    {"id": "c-state-fidelity", "name": "state fidelity", "aliases": [], "description": "The property neither NIST nor FCSM frameworks address directly.", "anchor": "addresses state fidelity", "location": "8 Institutional Grounding"},
    {"id": "c-confabulation", "name": "confabulation", "aliases": [], "description": "A generative AI risk defined by NIST AI 600-1; detection of it is unspecified for particular statistical domains.", "anchor": "defines confabulation as a generative", "location": "8.1 The NIST AI RMF and TEVV"},
    {"id": "c-specification-gap", "name": "specification gap", "aliases": [], "description": "The gap between the NIST/FCSM frameworks and operational practice that SFV is offered to fill.", "anchor": "a specification gap exists", "location": "8.1 The NIST AI RMF and TEVV"},
    {"id": "c-quality-dimensions", "name": "quality dimensions", "aliases": ["FCSM quality dimensions"], "description": "Accuracy, reliability, relevance, timeliness, accessibility, and transparency, which FCSM standards require federal statistical products to satisfy.", "anchor": "satisfy quality dimensions including", "location": "8.2 FCSM Quality Standards"},
    {"id": "c-accuracy", "name": "Accuracy", "aliases": ["accuracy"], "description": "The FCSM quality dimension directly threatened by False State Injection and State Supersession Failure.", "anchor": "Accuracy is directly threatened", "location": "8.2 FCSM Quality Standards"},
    {"id": "c-semantic-drift", "name": "Semantic Drift", "aliases": ["T1"], "description": "SFV threat T1; a consistency check misses it because the drifted term produces internally consistent outputs.", "anchor": "Semantic Drift (T1)", "location": "8.2 FCSM Quality Standards"},
    {"id": "c-false-state-injection", "name": "False State Injection", "aliases": ["T2"], "description": "SFV threat T2; directly threatens accuracy by corrupting the provenance chain.", "anchor": "T2 (False State Injection)", "location": "8.2 FCSM Quality Standards"},
    {"id": "c-compression-distortion", "name": "Compression Distortion", "aliases": ["T3"], "description": "SFV threat T3; threatens transparency when automated compaction strips decision rationale.", "anchor": "T3 (Compression Distortion)", "location": "8.2 FCSM Quality Standards"},
    {"id": "c-state-supersession-failure", "name": "State Supersession Failure", "aliases": ["T4"], "description": "SFV threat T4; applying superseded parameters threatens accuracy.", "anchor": "T4 (State Supersession Failure)", "location": "8.2 FCSM Quality Standards"},
    {"id": "c-state-discontinuity", "name": "State Discontinuity", "aliases": ["T5"], "description": "SFV threat T5; different operative states across sessions threaten reliability across administrations.", "anchor": "T5 (State Discontinuity)", "location": "8.2 FCSM Quality Standards"},
    {"id": "c-state-externalization", "name": "state externalization", "aliases": [], "description": "Moving critical pipeline state out of the mutable context window into durable infrastructure.", "anchor": "forms of state", "location": "8.3 Provenance as Institutional Infrastructure"},
    {"id": "c-provenance-infrastructure", "name": "provenance infrastructure", "aliases": [], "description": "Durable, queryable representation of pipeline state whose adoption was previously blocked by bookkeeping cost.", "anchor": "adoption of provenance infrastructure", "location": "8.3 Provenance as Institutional Infrastructure"},
